description: This file defines UI React components for a navigation menu using Radix UI primitives, including menu container, list, item, trigger, content, viewport, link, indicator, and related styles. It encapsulates the structure and styling logic for a customizable navigation menu in a React application.

methods.name: NavigationMenu
methods.description: Main navigation component wrapping radix root with optional viewport inclusion.

methods.name: NavigationMenuList
methods.description: Container for menu items, based on radix list component.

methods.name: NavigationMenuItem
methods.description: Represents an individual item in the navigation menu.

methods.name: NavigationMenuTrigger
methods.description: Trigger button that toggles menu open/close state, with icon indicator.

methods.name: NavigationMenuContent
methods.description: Wrapper for the menu's dropdown content, with animation and styling.

methods.name: NavigationMenuViewport
methods.description: Container for animated viewport area of dropdown menu.

methods.name: NavigationMenuLink
methods.description: Styled link component for menu navigation.

methods.name: NavigationMenuIndicator
methods.description: Visual indicator for menu state (e.g., arrow).
